en.t: Oborozukiyo had known this all along:

units.source_text: 朱雀帝容貌堂皇而清秀，对她的爱情无可限量，有增无已；

en.t: Emperor Suzaku was dignified and refined in appearance, and his love for her was boundless, only growing stronger with time;

units.source_text: 源氏公子呢，相貌固然漂亮，然而态度与感情都不及朱雀帝的真挚。

en.t: Prince Genji was certainly handsome, but neither his manner nor his feelings matched Emperor Suzaku's sincerity.

units.source_text: 因此她回想当初，常常痛悔前情：

en.t: Because of this, whenever she thought back to the past, she often bitterly regretted what had happened:

units.source_text: “为什么我在年幼无知之时任情而动，以致惹起滔天大祸。

en.t: “Why did I, when I was young and ignorant, act only on impulse and bring about such a terrible disaster?

units.source_text: 自己声名狼藉且不必说，竟又连累那个人受尽了折磨……”

en.t: It goes without saying that my own name was ruined, but I even dragged that person into it and made him suffer so much...”

units.source_text: 觉得自己真是一个薄倖女子！

en.t: She felt that she truly was an unfortunate woman.
